head_commit.message:
fix: publish official runtime through GitHub Web deploy (#1302)

Wait for the same source's completed GitHub Web build and public version, then publish the validated runtime environment inside the shared prebuilt deployment queue. Preserve pending releases and validate release-control changes without changing runtime model selection or identity trust.

Refs #1210
